messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - gpu-autoscaler@us-west-2 reported repeated scale failures for pool `gpu-pool-1`. queue_length=4200 -> sustained growth for 7m, autoscaler attempted scale but hit scale limit / provider errors. Severity: high. https://internal.metrics/gpu-pool-1

alice: Oncall here. Seeing a spike in queue and a bunch of job retries. Opening this thread for live triage. Who's available to take the bridge? :rotating_light:

ben: I'm on it. Pulling autoscaler logs now. ETA 2m.

charlie: I'll join the bridge — also will check the rate of 429s to cloud provider. Could be quota or SKU exhaustion.

ops-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/6181239999. PagerDuty incident #INC-78421.

dee: CS pinged: ~15 customers seeing elevated 5xx on hosted inference routes, some timeouts ~ 30s. Customer-impacted requests are mostly long-context generation jobs.

ben: Logs: autoscaler attempted alloc -> cloud returned `QuotaExceeded` and `InsufficientInstanceCapacity`. Sequence:
```
2026-03-15T01:04:12Z autoscaler DEBUG attemptScale: desired=40 current=12
2026-03-15T01:04:13Z cloudapi ERROR ProvisionInstance: QuotaExceeded: quota vCPU 640/640
2026-03-15T01:04:14Z cloudapi ERROR ProvisionInstance: InsufficientInstanceCapacity: no matching SKU
2026-03-15T01:04:15Z autoscaler WARN scaleFailed: reasons=[QuotaExceeded, InsufficientInstanceCapacity]
```

ben: Provider 429s + quota errors. Autoscaler backoff logic is healthy but fallback path didn't trigger to route traffic to fallback pool. Investigating routing policy.

charlie: Metrics: queue growth is concentrated on tenant-tag=prod-highmem. They pushed a large backfill at 00:50 UTC. That increased long-running requests.

alice: Immediate mitigation options: 1) apply temporary priority shed for backfill tenant, 2) increase provider quota (slow), 3) fail-fast low-priority requests, 4) route critical traffic to dedicated pool if capacity exists. Which is fastest?

dee: Option 1 + 3 are fastest. We should fail-fast backfill and throttle longest requests. CS can message high-impact customers.

eve: Confirmed: we've notified top 3 affected accounts. They've accepted temporary rate-limits if it resolves impact. Will keep them updated.

ben: Trying quick throttle: applying rate-limit rule to service `gen-long` for tenant prod-highmem -> set concurrency=2, timeout=15s. Pushing now.

ops-bot: Runbook step executed by ben: applied emergency throttle.

alice: Observed queue drop after throttle took effect. Queue from 4200 -> 1800 in 4m. Good. But autoscaler still failing to provision new instances because provider quotas.

charlie: I'm contacting cloud-account on call to request temporary quota bump for vCPU. If they can approve within 15-30m we can let autoscaler finish. Also asking for allocation of alternate SKU.

ben: Found a bug: autoscaler filters instance SKUs by `gpu:highmem` tag and the provider rotated SKUs yesterday; our fallback SKU list didn't include the new ids. If quota is bumped we might still fail. Quick patch: relax SKU filter to include fallback SKUs. I'll build a hotfix.

alice: Can we hotpatch or do a config flip? Which is faster?

ben: Config flip to enable `allow_fallback_skus=true` is easiest. Patching now.

ben: Patch rolled: autoscaler now accepts fallback SKUs. Immediately seeing a handful of successful provisions but still some `InsufficientInstanceCapacity` until provider schedules.

charlie: Cloud account confirmed temporary vCPU bump request submitted. Waiting approval.

dee: Customer errors dropping from 12 tickets -> 4 tickets in last 10m. Good sign.

ops-bot: Noted incident timeline in incident tracker. Added link to bridge transcript.

alice: Summary of live mitigations: - emergency throttle applied to backfill tenant (dee/ben) - autoscaler config flip to allow fallback SKUs (ben) - quota request to provider (charlie) - bridge active and CS notified (ops-bot/eve)

charlie: Provider approved partial vCPU bump (temporary +24 vCPU) — autoscaler now provisioning. Observed new nodes join pool at 01:18 UTC. Queues dropping steadily.

ben: Autoscaler logs show scale success: desired reached 36 -> current 36. No further failures.

alice: Traffic and 5xx rates returning to baseline. Closing bridge in 10m unless we see regression.

eve: I'll send a post-incident customer note to the accounts we contacted: short explanation and mitigation steps taken.

sre_lead: Postmortem checklist items (to be captured in PM):
- Root cause: autoscaler SKU filtering + lack of fallback SKUs + concurrent quota exhaustion due to large backfill.
- Contributing factors: backfill without rate-limits, autoscaler hard filter, no automated SKU discovery, provider quota close to baseline.
- Immediate remediations (done): emergency throttle, config flip for fallback SKUs, temporary quota bump.
- Action items (owners & ETA):
  * Add automated SKU fallback discovery & tests (ben) - ETA 2026-03-22
  * Implement tenant-level backfill guardrails (dee) - ETA 2026-03-18
  * Enhance autoscaler error classification to trigger alternate routing earlier (charlie) - ETA 2026-03-19
  * Add alert for vCPU utilization approaching quota (sre_lead) - ETA 2026-03-17
  * Run a chaos test that simulates SKU rotation + quota pressure (alice/ben) - ETA 2026-04-01

alice: I'll own the incident timeline and initial draft of the postmortem. Planning to publish preliminary notes within 24h.

ben: I'll open PR for autoscaler fallback test + config default change.

dee: I'll scope tenant backfill guardrails & propose rate-limit defaults.

charlie: I'll coordinate quota baseline review with cloud infra and add runbook steps for provider-429 handling.

sre_lead: Good work everyone. Retrospective meeting scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Leave any addtl notes in the incident tracker. :thumbsup:

alice: Closing this thread for now; keeping watch on dashboards for 2h. If we see regression, reopen. Thanks all. :pray:
